# Cary Roofing (caryncroofing.com)
> Premier roofing contractor network and authoritative technical roofing guide for Cary, North Carolina, and Wake County.

CaryRoofing provides turnkey residential and commercial roof replacement, precision leak repairs, 24/7 storm damage emergency response, architectural shingle installations, standing seam metal roofing, and gutter systems. All work strictly complies with Chapter 9 of the North Carolina Residential Building Code (NCRC) and Town of Cary Inspections Department requirements.

## Core Services
- [Roof Installation Services Cary NC USA](/roof-installation-services-cary-nc-usa.html): Full roof installations featuring GAF Timberline HDZ, CertainTeed Landmark, and Owens Corning Duration architectural shingles.
- [Roof Repair Services Cary NC USA](/roof-repair-services-cary-nc-usa.html): 21-point diagnostic roof leak repairs, flashing restorations, plumbing collar replacements, and chimney counter-flashing.
- [Roof Replacement Services Cary NC USA](/roof-replacement-services-cary-nc-usa.html): Complete tear-off, decking re-nailing, synthetic underlayment, ice-and-water barrier, and 50-year manufacturer warranty systems.
- [Storm Damage & Emergency Roofing Cary NC](/storm-emergency-roofing-services-cary-nc-usa.html): 24/7 emergency dispatch, roof tarping, tree strike stabilization, hail damage reports, and insurance claim support.
- [Commercial & Industrial Roofing Cary NC](/commercial-industrial-roofing-cary-nc-usa.html): TPO, EPDM, PVC single-ply membranes, and commercial roof coating restorations.
- [Metal Roofing Services Cary NC](/metal-roofing-services-cary-nc-usa.html): 24-gauge standing seam metal roofing with Kynar 500 finish, Class 4 impact resistance, and 140+ mph wind rating.
- [Cary NC Roofing Calculator](/cary-nc-roofing-calculator.html): Interactive cost estimator providing square-footage breakdowns, pitch multipliers, and material price comparisons.
